test_name: End-to-End UI Test - Watchlist Three-Button Analysis

summary.details: 2 scenarios passed, 1 failed due to data model bug, 2 blocked by backend bugs

scenarios.name: Three Buttons Visible Per Stock
scenarios.details: Verified 6 analysis buttons visible (2 stocks x 3 buttons each): quanliang, zengliang, chayi. Playwright test confirmed full_count=4, incr_count=4, diff_count=4 (duplicates from Streamlit re-render). DOM assertions passed.

scenarios.name: Button State Logic Correctness
scenarios.details: Expected: full=enabled (no running tasks), incremental=disabled (no full analysis today), diff=enabled (2+ completed analyses). Actual: full=enabled, incremental=disabled, diff=enabled. Incremental correctly disabled, but root cause is WRONG: _has_full_analysis_today() always returns False because AnalysisTask model lacks analysis_type column (see BUG-1).

scenarios.name: Click Full Analysis Triggers Analysis
scenarios.details: Clicked full button for 002172. UI responded with: (1) toast message confirming analysis started, (2) full button became disabled, (3) incremental and diff buttons became disabled. State transitions work correctly: enabled to disabled on click.

scenarios.name: Incremental Analysis Flow
scenarios.details: BLOCKED by BUG-1: _has_full_analysis_today() in watchlist_manager.py checks task.get('analysis_type') == 'full', but AnalysisTask model (database.py) does NOT have analysis_type column. WatchlistAnalysis model (separate table) has it, but /api/v1/analysis/ endpoint queries AnalysisTask. Result: incremental button is ALWAYS disabled, precheck dialog can never be reached.

scenarios.name: Diff Modal Display
scenarios.details: BLOCKED by BUG-2: FastAPI route ordering issue. POST /api/v1/analysis/diff-report returns 405 Method Not Allowed. Root cause: GET /{task_id} route (line 51) is defined BEFORE POST /diff-report (line 85) in analysis.py. FastAPI matches 'diff-report' as {task_id} parameter, and since {task_id} only has GET/DELETE methods, POST returns 405.

bugs_found.title: analysis_type column missing from AnalysisTask model
bugs_found.description: AnalysisTask ORM model (webapi/models/database.py) does not have analysis_type column, but watchlist_manager.py _has_full_analysis_today() checks task.get('analysis_type') == 'full'. The WatchlistAnalysis model (line 349) has analysis_type, but it is a separate table not queried by the /api/v1/analysis/ endpoint.
bugs_found.impact: Incremental button is permanently disabled. Users cannot run incremental analysis from the watchlist UI.

bugs_found.title: FastAPI route ordering prevents POST /diff-report
bugs_found.description: In webapi/routers/analysis.py, GET /{task_id} (line 51) is defined before POST /diff-report (line 85). FastAPI matches 'diff-report' as the {task_id} path parameter. Since {task_id} only accepts GET and DELETE, POST requests to /diff-report return 405.
bugs_found.impact: Diff button click triggers HTTP 405 error. Users cannot view analysis diff comparisons.
